lines.japanese: 閉店時間も差し迫った、夜９時のアレキサンダー。
lines.english: Nine in the evening at Alexander, with closing time fast approaching.

lines.japanese: 「私の時代が来たよ」
lines.english: “My time has come.”

lines.japanese: 英里子さんが唐突に言いだしました。
lines.english: Eriko made this sudden declaration.

lines.japanese: 「そうですか。おめでとうございます」
lines.english: “I see. Congratulations.”

lines.japanese: かまってほしいオーラぷんぷんのネタ振りに、スルー芸で対抗する日和子さん。
lines.english: Eriko had tossed out a line that reeked of wanting attention, and Hiyoko countered with the art of the deliberate brush-off.

lines.japanese: そのままぷいっと通りすぎてしまわないだけでも、少し前に比べてずいぶん柔らかくなったものだと感心してしまいます。
lines.english: The simple fact that she didn't march straight past afterward showed how much she had softened compared with a short while ago. It impressed me.

lines.japanese: そんなふたりの声を耳にしたら、心がぽかぽか温まるってもんです。
lines.english: Hearing the two of them together was enough to warm the heart.

lines.japanese: しかしまだ素直に会話を広げられない日和子さんに代わって、彼氏の千歳が承りましょう。
lines.english: But since Hiyoko still couldn't honestly keep the conversation going, her boyfriend Chitose would take the request.

lines.japanese: 「英里子さん、なんの話すか」
lines.english: “What are we talking about, Eriko?”

lines.japanese: 「や、さっきお客さんが、捨てといてくれって言って雑誌置いてったんだけど――」
lines.english: “A customer left this magazine earlier and asked us to throw it away—”

lines.japanese: 英里子さんは、御丁寧にもページを開いたまま、その女性誌を差しだしてきました。
lines.english: Eriko very thoughtfully held out the women's magazine with the relevant page already open.

lines.japanese: 「──ほら、見てよこの記事」
lines.english: “—look at this article.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだい、これ」
lines.english: “What's this?”

lines.japanese: お客さんとしていらしてた紀奈子さんも、横から輪に加わってきました。
lines.english: Kinako, visiting as a customer, leaned in from the side and joined the circle.

lines.japanese: 「受け身の男子が激増、いまアグレッシブな女の時代……」
lines.english: “‘Passive Men Surging: The Age of the Aggressive Woman Is Here’...”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。この記事がなにか」
lines.english: “Right. What about it?”

lines.japanese: 「見たまんまじゃん。アグレッシブな女、つまり私のことだろ。つまり私の時代だろ」
lines.english: “It's right there. An aggressive woman means me, obviously. Which means my time has come.”

lines.japanese: 英里子さんは誇らしげに胸を張っていましたが、彼女以外は微妙に首をひねっていました。
lines.english: Eriko proudly thrust out her chest. Everyone else tilted their heads uncertainly.

lines.japanese: 「なぜだろう……たしかに、日野英里子ほどアグレッシブという形容が似合う女のひとも、そうはいないのですが……」
lines.english: “Why is that...? It's true that few women suit the word *aggressive* as well as Eriko Hino...”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、そこまでは疑問を挟む余地もありません」
lines.english: “Yes. No one disputes that part.”

lines.japanese: 「だけど、えりちゃんの時代かって言われると、ちょっと……ねえ？」
lines.english: “But when you say it's Eri's time... Hmm?”

lines.japanese: 「アレキサンダー・望月と日野、どうして差がついたのか。慢心、環境の違い……」
lines.english: “Mochizuki and Hino, both of Alexander: what caused the gap between them? Arrogance? Differences in environment?”

lines.japanese: 「そういえば最近、英里子さんの合コン体験談、聞かなくなりましたね」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, Eriko, we haven't heard any stories about your group dates lately.”

lines.japanese: 「こないだの土曜なんか夜中ネットで延々つぶやいてたよ。『カップ麺なう』とか『通販番組なう』とか」
lines.english: “Last Saturday, she spent half the night posting online. Things like ‘cup noodles now’ and ‘shopping channel now.’”

lines.japanese: 「駄目だこいつ……早くなんとかしないと……」
lines.english: “This one's hopeless... Somebody needs to do something fast...”

lines.japanese: 「あのきっついとこさえなければモテモテなんでしょうけど、本人に反省の色がないすからねえ」
lines.english: “If she weren't so harsh, she'd probably be wildly popular. But she shows no sign of reflecting on herself.”

lines.japanese: 「ああッ！？　てめーらコソコソ言ってんじゃねーよ！」
lines.english: “The hell?! Quit whispering about me!”

lines.japanese: 「作画崩壊ｗｗｗｗｗ深夜アニメならスレも立たないレベルｗｗｗｗｗｗ」
lines.english: “QUALITY lolololol. So bad even a late-night anime wouldn't get a thread lolololol.”

lines.japanese: 「まーでも、えりちゃんの時代かは置いといて──」
lines.english: “Well, leaving aside whether it's Eri's time—”

lines.japanese: 「置くなよ」
lines.english: “Don't leave it aside.”

lines.japanese: 「──いまのカップルって、男の子の方が引っぱられてるの？　えー、男の子にはちょっと強引なぐらいにリードしてほしいよねー」
lines.english: “—are boys the ones being led around in modern couples? I want a boy to take charge, even if he's a little forceful.”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんが、声も出さずに小さく頷いていました。ええ、あの子はそうでしょう。
lines.english: Hiyoko gave a tiny, silent nod. Yes, of course she would.

lines.japanese: ええ、分かってますとも。表面的にはともあれ、彼女は本質的に、王子様シンドロームの夢見る女の子さんですからね。
lines.english: I understood perfectly. Whatever she seemed like on the surface, in her heart she was a dreamy girl with a prince-charming complex.

lines.japanese: ええ、だからこそ俺は恋愛面──ふたりで出掛けるときだとか、なにか選ぶときだとかは、ちょっと意識して、俺が仕切ってみたり前を歩いてみたりするわけです。
lines.english: And that was precisely why, in our romantic life—when we went somewhere together or had to choose something—I made a conscious effort to arrange things or walk a step ahead.

lines.japanese: ええ、まあ、仕事のときなんかは相変わらず、完っ全に日和子さん主導なんすけど……。
lines.english: At work, of course, Hiyoko remained completely in command.

lines.japanese: 「あ、でも紀奈子さん二浪してるから、周り年下の男ばっかでしょ。この本にあるみたく、リードする側のキャラになれば超モテんじゃない？　お母さん的立場で」
lines.english: “Oh, but Kinako, you've spent two extra years taking entrance exams, so all the boys around you must be younger. If you become the one who takes charge like this article says, maybe you'll be incredibly popular. In the role of their mother.”

lines.japanese: 「お姉さんでいいだろ？」
lines.english: “Couldn't you make that older sister?”

lines.japanese: 「んーじゃー、そう言う英里子アグレッシブさんは、彼氏にリードされたい願望とかないわけっすか」
lines.english: “Then what about you, Aggressively Eriko? Don't you ever want a boyfriend to take the lead?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ～？　そおゆわれちゃうとぉ、う～ん、ちょっぴりはあるけどぉ～」
lines.english: “Whaaat? When you put it that way... Hmm. Maybe a liiittle.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、べつに、くねンなくていいすけど」
lines.english: “You don't have to squirm while you say it.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、でもキホンねーかな。だって、男女関わらず、誰かの都合で動くなんてヤじゃない？　なんで他人ごときに私の行動決められなきゃなんねーんだよ」
lines.english: “But basically, no. Man or woman, I don't want to act according to somebody else's convenience. Why the hell should some random person decide what I do?”

lines.japanese: 「でも、決めてもらった方が楽だっぺ？」
lines.english: “But it's easier when somebody decides for you, ain't it?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、それに『提案してもらう』ってこと自体が、なんか嬉しいです。考えてもらってるんだなーって」
lines.english: “Yes. And merely having someone make a suggestion makes me happy. It means they were thinking about me.”

lines.japanese: チラ？　なんつって、アラヤダ奥さん、いまあの子、こっち見て目で微笑んだわよ。てへへ。
lines.english: Was that a glance? Why, my goodness, ma'am, that girl just looked over and smiled at me with her eyes. Teehee.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、相変わらずたまひよはおめでたいなァ」
lines.english: “Hah. Tama-chick is as naive as ever.”

lines.japanese: 「なにがですか」
lines.english: “What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「リードするなんてのは、綺麗に言いかえてるだけなんだよ。実際相手はただ自分のやりたいように動いて、周りを好き勝手振りまわしてるだけ」
lines.english: “‘Taking the lead’ is only a pretty way to phrase it. In reality, they do whatever they want and drag everyone around them according to their whims.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いや、それは単に英里子さんの自己紹介──」
lines.english: “N-no, that's simply Eriko describing herself—”

lines.japanese: 「ええーっ！　やだあ、最悪ー。そんなひとには引っ張ってもらいたくなーい」
lines.english: “What? Ew, that's awful. I wouldn't want someone like that leading me.”

lines.japanese: 「ハイ、紀奈子さんこっちに鞍替えー」
lines.english: “Right. Kinako has switched to my side.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　ちょっと、違いますって、紀奈子さんは相手によるって言ってるんですよ！」
lines.english: “What? No! That's not what she meant. Kinako said it depends on the person!”

lines.japanese: 「でー？　たまひよはどーすんの？」
lines.english: “Sooo? What about you, Tama-chick?”

lines.japanese: ひ、日和子さんはもちろん裏切りませんよ！　で、ですよね？
lines.english: H-Hiyoko certainly wouldn't betray me! R-right?

lines.japanese: 俺は余裕１０グラム、ハラハラ小さじ一杯の心持ちで恋人の回答を待ちました。
lines.english: I awaited my lover's answer with ten grams of composure and a teaspoon of anxiety.

lines.japanese: 「私はさっき言ったとおりです」
lines.english: “Exactly what I said before.”

lines.japanese: 「たしかに英里子さんの言うような、ただ自分本意なだけのひとだったら論外ですけど、そうではないって信じてますから」
lines.english: “Someone who was merely selfish in the way Eriko described would be out of the question. But I trust that he isn't.”

lines.japanese: ひ、日和子さああああーん！
lines.english: H-Hiyokoooooo!

lines.japanese: 俺は彼女を抱きしめたい衝動に駆られましたが、人前なので自分を抱きしめて我慢しました。
lines.english: The urge to embrace her overcame me, but we were in public, so I restrained myself by embracing my own body.

lines.japanese: 「千歳君よかったね、理解のある彼女で。感謝の気持ちを忘れちゃ駄目だよ」
lines.english: “Good for you, Chitose. You have an understanding girlfriend. Don't forget to be grateful.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あでぃがどうごだばず……日和子ざん、あでぃがどう……う、ううっ……」
lines.english: “Th-thag you berry buch... Hiyogo, thag you... Sniff...”

lines.japanese: 「も、もう……千歳さん、営業時間中ですよ、背筋を伸ばしてください」
lines.english: “R-really... Chitose, we're still open. Please stand up straight.”

lines.japanese: 「つーかさー、私の時代が来たってテーマトークだったのに、なんでいつの間にか千歳とたまひよのノロケ話になってんのー？」
lines.english: “Hold on. The topic was supposed to be how my time had come. How did this turn into Chitose and Tama-chick bragging about their relationship?”
